name: Data Stage 3D
description: Dark-arena 3D format for numbers and comparisons: volumetric spotlight cones, an instanced crowd of silhouettes, glossy objects lined up in rows that recede into depth, balance scales and filling tubes, with a big counter. A format, not a scene: the agent builds the stage, the objects and the props from scratch for each video. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 5-9 scenes (3-6 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with a `world` (concept, ground, parts, `crowd`) and `custom` objects built for THIS topic: rows of glossy objects via `repeat` (step [0, 0, -1.2]), a balance scale (two pans + beam with keys) or a filling tube (glass cylinder + inner cylinder scaling up). Add 1-3 fx type spotlight, a `stat` object as the counter, and `shots` (wide, low, close). No emoji.
